import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_43/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_43/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'school_name'
df_merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' (from df0)
# Aggregations:
# - sum of size (df0.size)
# - sum of budget (df0.budget)
# - average of math_score (df1.math_score)
# - average of reading_score (df1.reading_score)
# - sum of size again (for School Size column)

grouped = df_merged.groupby("type").agg(
    Total_Students=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
    Total_School_Budget=pd.NamedAgg(column="budget", aggfunc="sum"),
    Average_Math_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="math_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    Average_Reading_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="reading_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    School_Size=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
grouped.rename(
    columns={
        "type": "type",
        "Total_Students": "Total Students",
        "Total_School_Budget": "Total School Budget",
        "Average_Math_Score": "Average Math Score",
        "Average_Reading_Score": "Average Reading Score",
        "School_Size": "School Size",
    },
    inplace=True,
)

# Convert types to match target schema
grouped["type"] = grouped["type"].astype(str)
grouped["Total Students"] = grouped["Total Students"].astype(float)
grouped["Total School Budget"] = grouped["Total School Budget"].astype(float)
grouped["Average Math Score"] = grouped["Average Math Score"].astype(float)
grouped["Average Reading Score"] = grouped["Average Reading Score"].astype(float)
grouped["School Size"] = grouped["School Size"].astype(float)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' (from source0)
# Aggregations:
# Total Students = sum(size) from source0
# Total School Budget = sum(budget) from source0
# Average Math Score = avg(math_score) from source1
# Average Reading Score = avg(reading_score) from source1
# School Size = sum(size) from source0 (same as Total Students)

agg_df = joined.groupby("type").agg(
    Total_Students=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
    Total_School_Budget=pd.NamedAgg(column="budget", aggfunc="sum"),
    Average_Math_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="math_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    Average_Reading_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="reading_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    School_Size=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match exactly target schema (spaces, capitalization)
agg_df.columns = [
    "type",
    "Total Students",
    "Total School Budget",
    "Average Math Score",
    "Average Reading Score",
    "School Size",
]

# Write output
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
